scenes.heading: Why you're seeing pay ranges
scenes.from: Opening: the corpus's commitment framing — new state laws, ranges on all U.S. postings, transparency-builds-trust. The commitment section is the elected hook (intent_map): its sentence is employee-facing, where the guide document root's title is manager-facing copy and stays coverage. Serves orientation; binds no objective.

scenes.heading: How pay is determined
scenes.from: The three philosophy principles with their explanations, then how base pay is set (grades, zones, min/mid/max, typical range positions), then two enterprise-stewardship activities that show the factors are actively maintained (market surveys, role analyses). Stewardship items 1/4/5 stay coverage — manager-planning flavored. Serves obj_bw_emp_pay_factors.

scenes.heading: Base pay is one part of total rewards
scenes.from: Total-rewards frame, variable-compensation kinds, then the Total Rewards Statement (what it includes, where it lives — Workday — and the international caveat, honesty the source itself carries). The abstract total-rewards purpose statement stays coverage. Serves obj_bw_emp_total_rewards; the TRS block also serves obj_bw_emp_find_resources.

scenes.heading: How performance moves pay over time
scenes.from: Base salary vs. annual incentives, merit reviews, the Achieve link, and the BPP — the over-time story the employee LO names. Serves obj_bw_emp_perf_over_time. The two lesson-end invert-definition checks retrieve from this scene.

scenes.heading: Where to learn more — and your EU rights
scenes.from: Employee-visibility practices (Workday, TRS, merit letters), the FAQ pointer, and the EU right-to-information — recognition-level, per the SOW's 'delivered separately' note on EUPTD detail. Practices items 1–3 (foundation / postings / town halls) stay coverage. Serves obj_bw_emp_find_resources and obj_bw_emp_eu_rights.

note: Closed project catalog — the employee-awareness course design as data. ~46 of 70 occurrences on the spine; everything else is coverage, not deleted. Scene headings/kickers are authored designer copy; membership is refs only.
